name: Pu Kena Coffee
notes: Coffee trailer at 98-291 Kamehameha Hwy, ʻAiea (central side), next to Shay's Smashburgers. The Star-Advertiser (Sept 2026) names the Instagram handle @pukena.coffee and says orders are in person only. A job post for a barista ran until 9/13/2026, so it is currently operating. Fixed location, not a rotating schedule. No website or Facebook page found, so both are null.

name: Pupukea Grill
notes: Permanent lunch wagon at 59-680 Kamehameha Hwy, across from Shark's Cove; Roaming Hunger says it was established in 2008. The website URL comes only from a third-party listing (Wanderlog) and I could not open it to confirm. No Instagram or Facebook found. Hours differ between listings, so none are given. Current operating status not confirmed from an official or dated source.

name: Ry's Poke Shack
notes: Original shop at 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku Sugar Mill. Its own site lists Kahuku hours of Tue-Fri 11:30 AM-4:00 PM. The business has since opened a Honolulu location (1232 Waimanu St #2) and mainland locations; the seed refers to the North Shore Kahuku shop. Its social handles were not in the results, so Instagram and Facebook are null. Listed on oahufoodtrucks.org/member/RysPokeShack.

name: Sabrozon Fresh Mexican Food Truck
notes: Fixed truck at 575 Cooke St, Kakaʻako, Mon-Sat 11 AM-8 PM, closed Sunday (Apple Maps business info). The listings show the website as sabrozonmexicanfood.com without a scheme, so https is assumed. The ordering page is the truck's Toast page (the page title is spelled 'Sabronzon'). A ma.to page uses the label 'sabrozon_hi', but that may not be an Instagram handle, so Instagram is null. Active per an ordering page and listings from the last few months. No rotating schedule; it is a permanent spot.

name: Shawarma Break
notes: Pop-up vendor with no fixed location. The Instagram bio and a post (Aug 2026) advertise a Kaiser High School market on Aug 8, 2026, and Aloha State Daily (Aug 2026) lists its recent events. It also appears on the Marketspread vendor page (https://marketspread.com/vendor/216927/shawarma-break/) and as an Oahu Food Hub member. No website or Facebook page found.

name: Shay's Smashburgers
notes: Orange truck at 98-291 Kamehameha Hwy, ʻAiea, phone 808-460-0951. The Star-Advertiser (Mar 2025) names @shayssmashburgers and lists in-person and DoorDash ordering, but I did not open the Instagram page itself. A recent Apple Maps review of the neighboring Pu Kena Coffee places Shay's next to it, so it is likely still operating. Hours differ between third-party listings, so none are given. No official website or Facebook page found.

name: Sugah Daddeh's Kane Juice
notes: Stand at the Kahuku Sugar Mill, 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy, phone 808-348-9275. The only website shown is thecountryeatery.com in a MapQuest listing; the domain does not match the business name, so I left the website null. An auto-generated menu page (sugah-daddehs-kane-juice.menufyy.com) is not an official site. A separate Sugah Daddehs storefront exists in Kailua (342 Kuulei Rd), which is not the North Shore stand. No official social accounts found. No dated source confirms it is currently open.

name: Surf N Salsa
notes: Haleʻiwa food truck. Its own site and the Toast page both exist. The address differs by source: Toast and Wanderlog give 66-521 Kamehameha Hwy, while Restaurant Guru gives 67-106 Kealohanui St, Waialua; I did not pick one. The site snippet I saw is about 2.5 years old, so it is only likely to be current. A TikTok page mentions '@Surf&SalsaHawaii', but that is a TikTok name and I could not confirm Instagram or Facebook accounts.

name: Tako4u
notes: Takoyaki truck run by HI Sky International. The Star-Advertiser (Sept 9, 2026) reports a set weekly schedule, 4-9 pm: Mon Salt Lake Target, Wed Costco Waipio, Fri Kapolei Public Library, Sun across from Raising Cane's in Hawaiʻi Kai. The May 2025 article names @tako4uhawaii as the place for location updates, so I used it as the schedule source. I did not open the Instagram page. The company's separate Tacos 4U truck (@tacos4u808) is a different business. The truck covers many parts of Oʻahu, so the side is set to town as in the seed.

name: Tanaka Kahuku Shrimp
notes: Brick-and-mortar takeout at 56-931 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku; successor to Fumi's Kahuku Shrimp per Honolulu Magazine. The Instagram bio matches ('Da best garlic shrimp in North shore Hawaii'), with posts through Jan 2026; the page does not state an address. A travel article from the last month also covers it. The order link is third-party delivery (Uber Eats), not the business's own ordering. No website or Facebook page found.

name: Tango Argentinian Empanadas
notes: Run by siblings Julieta and Lucas Garnil. The Instagram bio (posts through June 2026) says daily at Kahuku Sugar Mill 10am-8pm and at Atkinson Dr, Ala Moana (10-2pm and 5-9pm). Its website lists weekly farmers markets: Thu Waimea Valley, Fri Fisherman's Wharf Ala Moana, Sun Kailua; those are about 15 months old. Kahuku address is 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy. No Facebook page found.

name: TaquerEATa
notes: All results for 'taquerEATa' describe a truck in Lahaina, Maui (741 Waine'e St). A listing marks it permanently closed, and Wanderlog also says permanently closed. I found no North Shore Oʻahu business of this name, so I assigned no handles or URLs. The seed may be a mismatch or a different Oʻahu vendor.

name: Taqueria Hawaii
notes: MapQuest describes a mobile truck in Mililani (200 Akamainui St, phone 808-927-6855) serving Mexican-Chinese-Hawaiian fusion, on weekday lunch hours and at weekend farmers markets. The seed says Town/Honolulu but Mililani is in central Oʻahu, so the side here is central. I could not confirm this is the same vendor and found no official social accounts or website. No dated source on current status.

name: Taro Hut
notes: Purple taro-bun burger truck at 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku Sugar Mill, phone 808-209-5210. Its Facebook page lists Mon-Sat 9am-7:30pm. A second Facebook page (facebook.com/100067892259005/) lists tarohut.com and sales@tarohut.com. The website was taken from that page. A 'Taro Hut Truck' at 56-505 Kamehameha Hwy (phone 808-746-3590) in an older directory looks like a different or earlier business. No Instagram found. No dated source confirms current status.

name: The Corndog Company of Hawaii
notes: Kahuku truck, phone 808-282-3672. Its Facebook page lists thecorndogco.com, which also appears on Roadtrippers. Most sources give 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy (Kahuku Sugar Mill) and some give 56-481 Kamehameha Hwy. Posted hours differ between sources, so none are given. The newest dated evidence I found is from Aug 2025, so current status is unconfirmed. No Instagram found.
